sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Yuzan, the Musician Puppet (三号乐偶师 玉瓒) is a story encounter in Village of Lu, found at Drop into the puppet well after Bi Yuan and Bi Hai. Beating it yields Heartrend Pipa.

sections.title: Where to Find the Yuzan, the Musician Puppet (三号乐偶师 玉瓒)
sections.content:
Location: Drop into the puppet well after Bi Yuan and Bi Hai.

Appears in: Village of Lu.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Yuzan, the Musician Puppet (三号乐偶师 玉瓒)
sections.content:
What works

  • Evade the projectile patterns and hit between them; the pipa volleys have a fixed rhythm.
  • Dropped into the puppet well after both Bi fights.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 19 of 60 in the progression order, in Village of Lu. Before it: Master Bi Hai. After it: Dusk, the Puppeteer. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
